  351: **The problem**: ε_H changes SIGN between cutoff families.
  352: - sqrt(x): ε_H = +0.02163 → n_s = 0.9567 (RED tilt, Planck-compatible)
  353: - Zeta/exponential: ε_H < 0 → n_s > 1 (BLUE tilt, excluded)
  354: - n_s spread across functionals: 0.164 (39× Planck error bar)
  355: 
  356: **Resolution path**: Anomaly + conservation hierarchy → one-parameter dilaton family c_k(φ)=(−1)^k φ^k/k. Bayesian evidence collapses model space: exp(−x) excluded at 15.5σ, compact at 36.9σ. Only sqrt(x) and anomaly(φ) survive. Higgs mass discriminant: m_H^{zeta}~174 GeV vs m_H^{cutoff}~127.5 GeV. Observation at 125.1 GeV selects cutoff at percent level.
  357: 
  358: **Status**: FUNCTIONAL-SELECT-67 is a CRITICAL S67 gate.

  361: 
  362: **The problem**: A_s gap 3.15 OOM. "Right universe, wrong volume."

  364: - All absolute AMPLITUDES fail (A_s, CC, H₀)
